otel_genai.reason: TWO INDEPENDENT BLOCKERS remain, and neither is the one this file used to name. A THIRD -- the retriever's output payload -- was real and is now FIXED (TASKS.md 2.17), which is why this reason is shorter than it was. BLOCKER 1, s1.inputs: `absent` here, `present` in openinference. The OTel GenAI dialect has NO content attribute for an embeddings span at all -- opentelemetry-util-genai 1.1b0's EmbeddingInvocation emits gen_ai.embeddings.dimension.count, gen_ai.request.encoding_formats, gen_ai.response.model and token counts, and nothing carrying the embedded text. So there is no attribute to render, and rendering the text under gen_ai.input.messages would be inventing one. FIXTURES.md 4.4 forbids declaring a payload's `state` away, ever: absent != present is the model's central honesty claim and a disagreement about it must stay visible. This blocker is a property of the dialect, not an adapter gap, and no captured trace can retire it -- only a change to the convention could. BLOCKER 2, s0: the chain parent, for the reason cyclic_parents and span_links carry. gen_ai.operation.name has no value denoting a chain, and the one candidate, invoke_workflow, was decided at TASKS.md 2.16 and endorsed: NOT mapped. The load-bearing ground is provenance, not definition. No instrumentor can ever emit an invoke_workflow span -- an instrumentor wraps SDK calls and a workflow is not one -- so the mapping would rest permanently on renderings derived from spans we emit ourselves, for the whole class and not just today. capture/README.md's rule binds: evidence you generated from your own idea of the outside world is not evidence. BLOCKER 1 OUTLIVES BLOCKER 2 and was measured to: even with invoke_workflow hypothetically mapped to chain, this scenario still fails on s1.inputs alone. So it must NOT be retired alongside cyclic_parents and span_links if that decision is ever reversed. WHAT WAS FIXED: s2.outputs now agrees exactly. The adapter reads gen_ai.retrieval.documents (application/json, parsed) and gen_ai.retrieval.query.text (text/plain, not parsed). NEITHER ATTRIBUTE APPEARS IN ANY CAPTURED TRACE IN THIS REPO -- three traces, 17 spans, and no retrieval or embeddings span among them. They were mapped from opentelemetry-util-genai 1.1b0's _retrieval_invocation.py, the support library the captured traces' own instrumentor delegates to for gen_ai.input.messages: same source, same version. The registry alone would not have done, because in opentelemetry-semantic-conventions 0.65b0 every gen_ai.* docstring has been replaced by the notice that the conventions moved house. That provenance is weaker than a capture and is recorded as such (ADAPTERS.md 3, FIXTURES.md 5.1).
